description: Shared vectors for the K_seat keyed hashes (T-182 design note section 4; backend-api.md section 4.3, backend-schema.md section 3). HMAC-SHA256 under K_seat, computed inside the KMS. UUIDs are their 36-character lower-case hyphenated ASCII text; publicKey is the raw 65-byte X9.63 point. installKeyHash = HMAC(K_seat, 'install' || 0x00 || installId || publicKey) (109-byte input); seatKeyHash = HMAC(K_seat, purchaseId || publicKey) (101-byte input); seatCheck = HMAC(K_seat, 'zaghlol-kseat-check-v1') (22-byte input; deployment.md section 3 Kms:HmacKeys:SeatCheck). The key is the synthetic test key 00 01 .. 1f; expected values were computed independently with Python hmac. No real key or install.
